topic: Credit score 580 vs 780 — five year financial health (Lily vs Eve)

scenes.narration: Two hundred credit points equal eighty thousand on a mortgage. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard with a credit score chart, comic burst banner reads EIGHTY THOUSAND DIFFERENCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lily and Eve are both thirty two and buying their first home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of woman lily and woman eve each holding identical house key icons in front of a three hundred thousand dollar starter home, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lily's credit score is five hundred eighty, Eve's is seven hundred eighty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side lily at a clinic desk with a chart reading FIVE EIGHTY, right side eve with a chart reading SEVEN EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lily missed payments two years ago and never disputed the errors.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, lily at a desk with a credit report covered in red flags labeled MISSED PAYMENT and ERROR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She also keeps her cards near the credit limit every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, lily holding a credit card with a utilization gauge stuck at NINETY PERCENT in red, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eve pays every bill on auto and disputes errors within thirty days.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, eve at a kitchen table with a clean credit report stamped GREEN, autopay icons next to every bill, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She keeps her balances under ten percent of the credit limit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, eve holding a credit card with a utilization gauge stuck at TEN PERCENT in green, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lily's mortgage rate comes back at eight point one percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, lily at a closing table holding a paper labeled EIGHT POINT ONE PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her monthly payment is twenty two hundred dollars and she is house poor.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked lily holding a calculator reading TWENTY TWO TWENTY A MONTH, empty fridge behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eve locks in six point one percent on the very same loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, eve at a closing table holding a paper labeled SIX POINT ONE PERCENT with a smile, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She pays eighty two thousand less over thirty years on identical houses.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side lily with a heavy mortgage statement, right side eve with a paper banner reading EIGHTY TWO THOUSAND SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Autopay every bill. Stay under ten percent utilization. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
